prompt: You discover your younger sibling has read a private journal page you left in a shared room and has been joking about one line from it. What is the most constructive response?

options.text: Read something private of theirs so you are even
Tell them calmly that private writing is out of bounds, ask them to stop the jokes, and keep the journal somewhere private in future
Never write anything personal down again
Shout at them in front of the whole family until they cry

explanation: Setting a clear, calm boundary and securing the journal protects your privacy without turning a sibling mistake into a family war.
